Class AnimationMenu

java.lang.Object
app.animation.AnimationMenu
public class AnimationMenu extends Object
Handles various animations for the main menu, such as title scaling, button hover effects, and menu transition animations.

  • Method Details

    • menuAnimation

      public void menuAnimation(javafx.scene.control.Label title, javafx.scene.control.Label[] buttons)
      Applies animations to the menu title and buttons. The title scales up and down continuously, and buttons fade in and out on hover.
      Parameters:
      title - The menu title label to animate.
      buttons - An array of button labels that will have hover effects.

    • startMenuAnimation

      public void startMenuAnimation(javafx.scene.layout.VBox centerPane, javafx.scene.Node[] nodes, javafx.scene.control.Label title)
      Applies an animated sequence to the main menu, including title fade-in, movement, and button animations. The animation consists of: - A pause before animations begin. - A fade-in effect for the title. - A translation effect that moves the title upward. - A fade-in effect for menu buttons. - A continuous scaling effect for the title.
      Parameters:
      centerPane - The VBox containing the menu elements.
      nodes - The menu buttons and interactive elements to animate.
      title - The menu title label to animate.

    • menuHover

      public void menuHover(javafx.scene.Node[] nodes)
      Applies a hover effect to menu nodes by adjusting their fade animation. If a node is an HBox, the effect is applied to all its child nodes as well.
      Parameters:
      nodes - The array of menu elements to apply the hover effect to.

    • fadeOutMainMenu

      public void fadeOutMainMenu(javafx.scene.Scene scene, javafx.scene.layout.VBox pane)
      Fades out all child elements of the specified VBox container using a fade-out animation and then initializes a new SinglePlayGameController to begin the character selection process.
      Parameters:
      scene - The current Scene where the fade-out animation is applied and where the game transition will occur.
      pane - The VBox container containing the menu elements to be faded out.

    • fadeInMainMenu

      public void fadeInMainMenu(javafx.scene.layout.VBox pane)
      Applies a fade-in effect to all child elements of the specified VBox container. Each child element transitions from fully transparent to fully opaque over 1.5 seconds.
      Parameters:
      pane - The VBox container whose child elements will have the fade-in animation applied.
